cardOverview.overviewText: A corporate card offering simplified expense management, accelerated points on business travel, and tools for organizations to track and optimize professional spends.

benefitRows.name: Airport Service
benefitRows.offer: One free fast-track immigration service.|One complimentary one-way luxury airport transfer service per travel plan.|Business class seats required for luxury airport transfer, non-business class passengers can use other services
benefitRows.howToAvail: To access the concierge services for a Primus card, you can call +91 120 445 4455. This number is specifically for the Axis Bank Primus card concierge service.

benefitRows.name: Airport Service
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary two-way luxury airport Meet & Assist Service per itinerary at participating airports across the world on the purchase of business class & above ticket settled with his/her Axis Bank PRIMUS Card.
